note: 每个已接入的操作都在 validation/apps/evidence/contract/ 下有请求、响应与退出码三件套；未接入的操作返回 unsupported（origin=contract.dispatch），不伪造结果。

observation_family.apply_scale: exit 0, code ok (the scaled values carry the issue 'the scaled values have no unconditional numerical certificate')
observation_family.fit_psf: the dispatch answers; the synthetic fixture has no support on the fit samples (the sources module), the code is nonconverged
observation_family.measure_science_sources: the dispatch answers; the synthetic fixture cannot build the point spread function template (the sources module), the code is invalid_model
observation_family.fit_photometry: the dispatch answers; the fixture has no response list, the code is invalid_request
observation_family.honest_note: 三个未通过的操作卡在合成夹具本身（支持域、点扩散函数模板、响应表），不是 dispatch：夹具需要用 x01 的真实帧构造（依赖 sources 模块的构造），证据如实保留。
